description: This file defines a specialized TrustManagerFactory named ValidityOnlyTrustManagerFactory, which provides a TrustManager that validates X.509 certificates based on their validity dates ('not before' and 'not after') only, without performing signature verification. It is likely used in an SSL/TLS context for certificate validation based solely on validity periods.

classes.name: ValidityOnlyTrustManagerFactory
classes.description: A custom TrustManagerFactory that supplies a TrustManager which only validates the current date against certificate validity periods.

methods.name: engineInit (KeyStore)
methods.description: Initializes the TrustManagerFactory with a KeyStore, but this implementation does nothing.

methods.name: engineInit (ManagerFactoryParameters)
methods.description: Initializes the TrustManagerFactory with parameters, but this implementation does nothing.

methods.name: engineGetTrustManagers
methods.description: Returns an array with a single TrustManager that performs date-based validation of X.509 certificates.
